# A reactive `if` among a markup list's items. md.list and md.listItem each
# take their content through a rest slot, so an item under the `if` is a
# component built at run time handed bare children -- which html, fyne and
# gtk4 met as an *ir.SlotInst in irwalk and panicked on until passInstanceSlots
# gave each such instantiation a copy with its children spliced in.
#
# On html the item is removed and put back where it was written, ahead of the
# one after it. gtk4 is asserted to build and run.


env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
grep '(?s)<span>shown</span>.*<span>always</span>' app.sngl.snapshots/back.html

[!gtk4] stop 'gtk4 needs its development libraries to build'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 nosnap.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import md "sngl:ui/markup"

output { none { html } }

component main node {
    var show = true

    vbox {
        button #flip(text="flip", @click { show = !show })
        md.list {
            if show {
                md.listItem {
                    text(value="shown")
                }
            }
            md.listItem {
                text(value="always")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testBack(t Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    c.flip.click()
    t.snapshot("back")
}

window {
    main
}
-- nosnap.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"
import md "sngl:ui/markup"

component main node {
    var show = true

    vbox {
        button #flip(text="flip", @click { show = !show })
        md.list {
            if show {
                md.listItem {
                    text(value="shown")
                }
            }
            md.listItem {
                text(value="always")
            }
        }
    }
}

func testFlip(t Test, c main) {
    c.flip.click()
    t.assert(!c.show)
}

window {
    main
}
